name: app-health-tiles-and-serif-insight-card-cropped-thumbnail
title: Glass health tiles and serif recovery insight on a blue-violet gradient, thumbnail crop
whatItIs: A cropped lower half of a lavender phone on a blue-to-periwinkle gradient showing three glass tiles (38.4 VO2 Max, 62 BPM RHR, 22 ms HRV), a serif insight card 'Your HRV is down 15% this week. Try a recovery day.' with a black arrow and a floating tab bar with a pink Home pill.
whatItMeans: Calm and personal; serif sentences turn data into advice.
techniques: Crop a phone to its lower half.
Highlight the active tab in a pink pill.

vocabulary.definition: Showing only part of the device.
